name: sportsleague
description: Baseball league for the DEADBALL broadcast: persistent standings (`standings`) booked from every simulated game, plus monthly seasons that climax in a single-game World Series between the top two teams (`worldseries`, `champions`). Standings reset each season; champions are kept as history.

seasonDays.note: in-game days per season before the World Series (SPORTS_SEASON_DAYS in index.js)

minWorldSeriesGames.note: runner-up must have played this many before a Series can seed
